title: Fix broken Go middleware server — wrong status codes and unused imports
description: A Go todo server was damaged by a bad commit: ListTodos returns plain text instead of JSON, CreateTodo returns 200 instead of 201, and there is a dummy strconv usage hiding an unused import.

task_spec.prompt: The Go todo server in internal/handler/todos.go was broken by a bad commit. Fix three issues: (1) ListTodos calls fmt.Fprintln(w, "not implemented") instead of json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(todos) — restore the proper JSON encoding. (2) CreateTodo uses w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK) — change to w.WriteHeader(http.StatusCreated) (201). (3) Remove the dummy _ = strconv.Itoa(0) line and the now-unused fmt and strconv imports so go vet and go build produce no errors. Run go test ./... to confirm all three tests pass.
required_artifacts: No unused imports (fmt and strconv removed)
success_criteria: Server behaviour restored to original design
Clean Go code with no dead imports
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `go test ./...` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
